pass_criteria: Driving only place_input_shaft produces clearly visible rotation at place_stage2_output_wheel.
The measured output angular travel is nonzero and smaller than the input angular travel.
The supported shafts and gear stages remain assembled without tooth overlap, ejection, or sustained jamming.
design.environment: Bench-mount the reducer by fixing its baseplate and drive the hand-crank input shaft. The locked camera observes both gear stages and the visible input and output shafts so motion propagation and qualitative speed reduction are apparent.
